$comment: Plugins the Tauri build cannot run. "unavailable": no backend implementation on any platform; their menu and preload are left out of the page bundle (it imports main-process code). "unavailableOnMobile": desktop-only plugins (window, global shortcut, SOCKS relay and Discord features) that Android cannot use. Both are forced off and greyed out in the menu. "unavailableInMobileUi": plugins that need YouTube Music's own interface (its player bar, player page, queue store, menus or pages), which the mobile UI does not load: forced off and greyed out only while the mobile UI runs (Android, View > Pear mobile UI), still available with YouTube Music's interface. Why each one: docs/OWN-ENGINE.md. Read by vite.config.mts and src-tauri/src/config.rs.
